name: ALGEBRAIC_ROOT_EQUIVALENCE
description: Replaces the seed's recognizable matrix trace condition with a quadratic Diophantine equation $2p_u^2 - 5p_u p_v + 2p_v^2 = 0$. Over the allowed domain $\{1, 2\}$, this equation evaluates to $0$ if and only if $p_u \neq p_v$. This algebraically disguises the "different modes" constraint (bipartite coloring) without using the recognizable matrix traces from the seed, forcing models to algebraically deduce the inequality constraint instead of relying on memorized matrix properties.
